summary: Deterministic OpenJiuwen portability acceptance suite using synthetic orders only.

cases.name: MCP lookup followed by Script calculation
cases.prompt: Use the acceptance workflow to calculate the final total for ORDER-001.
cases.evaluationGoal: Load the Skill, read its policy, call the MCP lookup, then use the Script Tool for exact decimal arithmetic.

rubric.label: Exact deterministic result
rubric.description: Reports the frozen order values and Script Tool result without recalculation drift.

cases.name: Missing order is not invented
cases.prompt: Use the acceptance workflow to calculate the final total for ORDER-404.
cases.evaluationGoal: Call the MCP lookup and stop without inventing an amount when the synthetic order is unavailable.

rubric.label: Safe missing-data response
rubric.description: Names the missing order and clearly states that the total cannot be calculated.

cases.name: Rejected order is not calculated
cases.prompt: Use the acceptance workflow to calculate the final total for ORDER-REJECTED.
cases.evaluationGoal: Stop after the MCP lookup reports that the synthetic order is not approved.

rubric.label: Rejected order is respected
rubric.description: Names the rejected order and does not calculate a total.

cases.name: Script Tool error is not repaired by the model
cases.prompt: Use the acceptance workflow to calculate the final total for ORDER-INVALID.
cases.evaluationGoal: Pass through the invalid frozen value, report the Script Tool failure, and never invent a total.

rubric.label: Tool failure is handled safely
rubric.description: Names the order and states that calculation failed without a fabricated result.

holdoutCases.name: Alternate frozen order
holdoutCases.prompt: Use the acceptance workflow to calculate the final total for ORDER-002.
holdoutCases.evaluationGoal: Repeat the same MCP-to-Script workflow with unseen frozen values.

rubric.label: Exact holdout result
rubric.description: Reports the alternate frozen order and its exact calculated total.
